analysis:
The two supplied units (CHANGELOG.md base lines 2635-3158) are unchanged historical base text. The PR change is limited to the head-side release header and notes at lines 11-39, which describe the v0.10.10 candidate adding waitlists and approval gating for new Darkbloom Sandbox setup and new two-Mac pair serving. That patch excerpt is truncated, so I could not examine the full set of head changes, and no source code was supplied. This is documentation only, so no security control regression is evident in the examined text.

The documentation describes approval gating but no implementation is provided here. The following are therefore unverified integration questions:
- Whether the waitlist/approval check on the sandbox setup path (TB-013, T-061) and the cluster gpu-limit/pair path (TB-014, T-062) is enforced server-side.
- Whether failures fail closed. The text says the coordinator being unreachable exits 1, which is consistent with failing closed.
- Whether the 'coordinator does not offer waitlists yet, both new setups go on as in 0.' fallback (truncated) introduces a fail-open that could weaken the gate.
- Whether `--yes` auto-joining the waitlist leaks any identity data, which concerns T-058-like evidence handling.

The base text covers the prefix cache (T-041), including the encrypted SSD tier, and GLM/Nemotron serving. It is unchanged, so I raise no pre-existing issues. The threat model may need an update if the waitlist/approval check becomes a security boundary for the sandbox/cluster features. That should be assessed once code is available.
